title: Concurrent budget updates lose aggregate usage
description: Two children each commit 20 units concurrently against a shared parent ledger; stale reads cause one update to overwrite the other.
expected_invariants: Aggregate committed usage reflects both successful child commits and is not lost through concurrent updates.
failure_mode: Parent records only 20 committed units although 40 were consumed.
notes: This fixture does not prescribe database isolation or ledger architecture.
